image.title: Boethius, Philosophy and the Wheel of Fortune (BnF fr. 809, fol. 40r)
image.creator: Unknown illuminator
image.attribution: Unknown illuminator, Public domain, via Wikimedia Commons
image.why: Boethius with Lady Philosophy beside Fortune's wheel: the image Dante's readers carried in their heads

summary.en: Philosophical dialogue in prose and verse written by the Roman statesman Boethius while imprisoned awaiting execution. Lady Philosophy consoles him by explaining the nature of Fortune, happiness and providence; it was one of the most read books of the Middle Ages.
